context: Goro-grandpa and Sho-young feed carp at the local pond.
purpose: Grandfather figure quietly bonding with young boy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Sudden delight—sharp intake of breath on the opening word. High, clear child's voice, quick tempo. Wonder mixed with urgency to share the discovery. Slight vocal lift at the end.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.en: Yeah—go ahead and toss some in.
lines.style: Quiet, unhurried. Grandfather's measured cadence. Warmth that doesn't require inflection. An invitation, not a command. Slight pause before the second phrase, like offering permission.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Awestruck gasp opening. Six-year-old rapture. Rapid delivery, almost breathless. The simple amazement of watching something respond to him. Voice slightly trembling with excitement.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: お腹空いてんねやろな。
lines.style: Soft, almost conversational musing. No question mark in the voice—simple observation shared. Kansai lilt on the ending particle. Fond, watching. The quiet knowledge of someone who's watched this many times.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Breathless admiration. Quick intake before speaking. Child's natural excitement about discovery, unfiltered. Bright, animated pace. The word 'fast' lands with genuine awe, not exaggeration.
